arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the match, the template can be selected with mouse on the window

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: match_method
arg.description: Matching method. 0: TM_SQDIFF, 1: TM_SQDIFF_NORMED, 2: TM_CCORR, 3: TM_CCORR_NORMED, 4: TM_CCOEFF, 5: TM_CCOEFF_NORMED

arg.name: match_threshold
arg.description: Minimum similarity of a match (score of TM_CCORR_NORMED and TM_CCOEFF_NORMED, 1 - score of TM_SQDIFF_NORMED), not used by the methods which are not normalized

arg.name: max_matches
arg.description: Maximum number of the matches. 1: the best match only, more than 1: the matches above match_threshold, after a non-maximum suppression

arg.name: template_file
arg.description: File name of the template image, it is replaced by the image on ~/template topic

arg.name: mask_file
arg.description: File name of the mask image of the template (non-zero pixels are used), it is replaced by the image on ~/mask topic
